pages.text: A cat sat at the end of the pier, warming itself in the sun and swishing its tail.
They wanted the cat to come beside them. Dad's boots stood nearby, smelling strongly of fish.
Riri quietly rose onto her toes. Lolo spread both arms wide. "Approach slowly." "Call, and it will come."
Riri took half a step closer. The cat pricked its ears.
Riri took another half step. The cat gave a huge yawn.
"Kitty!" Lolo called, rushing forward. The cat sprang up.
The cat jumped onto the roof and looked down at them.
Tired, they plopped down beside Dad's boots. A fishy smell drifted from them.
The cat crept down and sniffed with its nose against the boots.
It sat between them and curled into a ball. Neither Riri nor Lolo dared move. All three sat side by side in the sunshine.
